versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation
v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

Initial release of code-delegate-tool-free.

- Enables delegation of programming tasks to the local CLI with support for asynchronous flows and single-task debugging/iteration.
- Maintains session context for continued task iteration or independent session for testing.
- Ensures the Agent never writes code directly; all code tasks are executed via delegated commands.
- Provides robust error handling and common troubleshooting guides.
- Designed for individual developers needing task delegation, asynchronous execution, and isolated code testing features.
